Dashboard mengatakan query lambat, lalu: A dashboard says a query is slow, then someone sees `wait_event_type = 'Lock'` and immediately names one root cause. At the same timestamp there is an active session without a wait, a session waiting for I/O, and an idle transaction that may still hold a lock. How can we read pg_stat_activity as a limited snapshot, calculate query age deterministically, and distinguish a wait signal from a proven cause?

Menyusun snapshot diagnosis yang menghor: Build a diagnostic snapshot that respects a fixed timestamp, possible NULLs, query-text/privilege boundaries, and the need for further evidence.
pg_stat_activity adalah snapshot, bukan: pg_stat_activity is a snapshot, not a complete incident record
`pg_stat_activity` menyajikan satu baris: `pg_stat_activity` presents one row per server process visible to the reader's session privileges. `state` says whether a backend appears active, idle, or idle in transaction; it does not describe the full request history. `query_start` and `xact_start` also mean different things: query_start marks the start of the current or last reported query, while xact_start marks the start of the current transaction. Calculate both ages against the same observation time. This lesson uses `2026-10-25 09:00:00+07` as a fixed observation timestamp so age values can be calculated without `now()` or machine-timezone dependence.
Kolom NULL adalah informasi, bukan otoma: NULL columns are information, not automatically errors. An idle backend may have no active query_start or xact_start. NULL `wait_event_type` and `wait_event` in a snapshot mean that no wait event was being reported at that moment; they do not prove the backend was using CPU, that the query was healthy, or that repeated observation is unnecessary. Conversely, an active state with an IO wait type suggests a wait in the I/O family, but does not answer whether storage, cache, query shape, or another pressure is causing user latency. Take repeated snapshots and correlate them with application metrics before concluding.
`wait_event_type = 'Lock'` dan nama even: `wait_event_type = 'Lock'` and an event name such as `relation` show that the backend was waiting for a lock at the sample time. If the waiter has a `blocker_pid`, that pid is a candidate to trace; it is not automatically the root-cause actor because the blocker may itself be waiting, completing a legitimate business transaction, or visible only at one point in time. An `IO` event such as `DataFileRead` directs inspection toward the read path, but does not prove a bad disk or a missing index. An active backend with a NULL wait may be using CPU or between events too brief for the snapshot.
`idle in transaction` perlu perhatian be: `idle in transaction` needs different attention. It means the transaction remains open after the previous statement finished; a NULL wait_event does not mean all locks were released. Under some isolation levels, snapshots and locks can remain until COMMIT or ROLLBACK. Do not kill a pid based only on age or label. Correlate owner, xact_start, business transaction, blocker chain, timeout policy, and rollback impact. A good diagnosis says “lock-wait candidate” or “old transaction candidate” when that is what the data supports, rather than turning a wait category into a single cause.
Kolom query dapat tidak terlihat penuh b: The query column may not be fully visible when the user lacks permission to see query text or when the application deliberately redacts it. Query text may also contain email addresses, tokens, account numbers, or sensitive parameters. The fixture stores only `query_text_visible` and a redaction label, not secret payloads. A reviewer may ask the service owner for a sanitized query fingerprint, route, and parameter class. Do not copy raw queries into a public incident ticket. `pg_stat_activity` is not an audit log either; rows may change or disappear before an investigator reads them.
Urutan tindakan yang aman adalah menetap: A safe sequence is to set the observation timestamp, save a minimum sanitized snapshot, identify the waiter and blocker candidate, then request owner and transaction context. If termination or a timeout change is considered, write the prerequisites, expected SQLSTATE or result, business rollback impact, and reconciliation plan first. This lesson does not run `pg_terminate_backend`, change lock timeout, or sample a live system. The authored output only practices reading state, age, and evidence limits; it grants no operational permission and does not claim that a production incident was solved.

API p95 jumps from 180 ms to 920 ms. One person suggests increasing the pool, another wants to kill a blocker, and a third blames an index—all before saving a single snapshot. A good incident report starts with the symptom, three pieces of evidence with the same timestamp, falsifiable hypotheses, and guards for privacy and action impact. How do you write a diagnosis that is firm enough to move forward but bounded enough not to guess?
Membangun timeline authored dari API p95: Build an authored timeline from API p95, database mean, lock/IO waits, pool wait, active sessions, and error rate.
Menghubungkan beberapa sinyal menjadi hi: Connect multiple signals into a falsifiable hypothesis without calling correlation a root cause or runtime evidence.

Mulai dari gejala dan observation window: Start with the symptom and observation window
Diagnosis insiden bukan lomba memilih la: Incident diagnosis is not a race to choose the fastest label. Start with an observable symptom: for example, authored API p95 rises from 180 to 920 ms at 09:05, not “the database is broken.” Set the observation timestamp and window, then collect signals with matching definitions: p95 needs a request cohort, database mean must say whether it is server-side or end-to-end, pool wait must come from a pool metric, and waiters must come from an activity snapshot. If timestamps are far apart, correlation can mislead. Dataset O3 uses three authored time points so learners can calculate deltas without `now()` or a wall clock.
Satu metric jarang cukup. P95 API tinggi: One metric is rarely enough. High API p95 with a high database mean can direct query/lock/I/O inspection, but pool wait can also add latency outside the database. Rising lock waiters support a contention hypothesis in that window, but wait_event_type Lock does not select the root cause because the blocker chain and business transaction have not been inspected. Rising IO waiters while lock waiters are zero point elsewhere, but still do not prove a storage fault. Write “signal supports hypothesis H” and “evidence missing” explicitly. That makes the report falsifiable by the next snapshot, plan, trace, or controlled change.
Untuk O3, snapshot incident menunjukkan: For O3, the incident snapshot shows api_p95 920 ms, db_mean 700 ms, lock_waiters 12, pool_wait_ms 600, and active_sessions 30. This combination supports a bounded hypothesis: in the 09:05 window, contention and pool queuing are both candidate contributors to latency. It does not prove that one blocker caused every request, that increasing the pool will reduce p95, or that an index is the solution. Compare baseline and mitigation snapshots; if lock waiters fall but p95 remains high, a lock-only hypothesis weakens and pool, I/O, application work, or cohort mix should be investigated.
Hipotesis yang baik menyebut observasi y: A good hypothesis names the observation that would disprove it. For example: “If lock contention is the dominant cause, lock-waiter count and blocked duration should fall after the owner transaction finishes, while the query cohort remains comparable.” Another example: “If pool saturation is dominant, pool wait will grow as active connections approach the pool limit even while the database mean remains normal.” Do not turn these examples into universal numeric promises. `pg_stat_statements` is optional and an aggregate mean does not provide p95; raw query text may be redacted. The report should retain the query fingerprint, parameter class, config version, data size, privacy scope, and who approved access.
Sebelum kill atau tune, batasi risiko: Bound risk before killing or tuning
Terminate backend dan tuning pool adalah: Terminating a backend and tuning a pool can affect active transactions, rollback, retry storms, memory, and availability. Before acting, freeze a safe minimum snapshot: observation time, pid/session state, wait event, xact age, blocker chain, owner, query fingerprint, pool counters, error rate, and redaction status. Ensure the investigator has appropriate privileges and does not copy secrets. Ask the owner to confirm that the transaction can be canceled; if the commit outcome is unknown, prepare reconciliation by business key. If a reversible action is approved, set a success metric and stop condition before the change.
O3 hanya menghitung delta authored dan m: O3 only calculates authored deltas and produces hypothesis-support flags. It does not run termination, `SET`, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, an extension, or a benchmark. Candidate remediation must be tested within a bounded scope and compared with an equivalent before/after cohort. An honest report may end with “not enough evidence”; that is more useful than a false root-cause certificate. After the incident, separate what was observed, inferred, unknown, and which experiment would falsify the guess. In this format, observability becomes a safe learning loop, not a dashboard that forces context-free action.
Dataset O3 — timeline authored gejala ap: Dataset O3 — an authored timeline of application, database, lock/IO wait, pool, and error symptoms at fixed observation timestamps. Hypothesis flags are reasoning tools, not a production diagnosis.
Mengapa S2 tidak cukup untuk menyebut lo: Why is S2 not enough to call lock the single root cause?
Lock waiters adalah satu signal; pool wa: Lock waiters are one signal; pool wait, blocker chain, query cohort, I/O, and application behavior still need correlation and testing.
Karena lock_waiters selalu tidak berkait: Because lock_waiters are never related to API latency.
Karena semua p95 tinggi pasti disebabkan: Because every high p95 is definitely caused by disk I/O.
Multi-signal diagnosis mengubah angka me: Multi-signal diagnosis turns numbers into falsifiable hypotheses, not automatic labels.
Benar. Catat signal lock sebagai kandida: Correct. Record the lock signal as a candidate and name the evidence that is still missing.
Belum tepat. Lock contention dapat berko: Not quite. Lock contention may contribute, but it must be matched to the window and workload.
Belum tepat. P95 tinggi memiliki banyak: Not quite. A high p95 has many possible causes.
Apa isi minimum sebelum menyarankan term: What is the minimum content before recommending backend termination or increasing the pool?
Langsung jalankan perubahan lalu cari ev: Run the change immediately and look for evidence after the incident ends.
Snapshot timestamp, owner/blocker, xact: Snapshot timestamp, owner/blocker, transaction scope, privacy-safe query fingerprint, rollback/memory impact, approval, success metric, and stop condition.
Cukup satu screenshot dashboard tanpa ti: One dashboard screenshot without a timestamp is enough because the numbers will remain the same.
Tindakan operasional dapat membatalkan t: Operational action can cancel transactions or worsen resource pressure; evidence and guards must come first.
Belum tepat. Perubahan tanpa baseline da: Not quite. A change without a baseline and stop condition is hard to reverse and audit.
Benar. Bukti, owner, privacy, approval,: Correct. Evidence, owner, privacy, approval, and resource risk must be preconditions.
Belum tepat. Snapshot berubah cepat dan: Not quite. Snapshots change quickly, and an untimed screenshot cannot establish a timeline.
Apa arti report yang menyatakan “belum c: What does a report saying “not enough evidence” mean?
Report gagal total dan harus memilih roo: The report has failed completely and must choose a root cause speculatively.
Report jujur memisahkan observed, inferr: An honest report separates observed, inferred, unknown, and next evidence; the hypothesis can still be tested without a certification claim.
Report boleh menghilangkan semua metric: The report may omit every metric that does not support the main hypothesis.
Diagnosis yang dapat difalsifikasi memer: A falsifiable diagnosis needs knowledge limits and a plan for the next measurement.
Belum tepat. Menahan klaim adalah bagian: Not quite. Withholding a claim is part of safe diagnosis.
Benar. Unknown yang eksplisit membuat la: Correct. Explicit unknowns make the next step and risk clearer.
Belum tepat. Menghapus metric yang tidak: Not quite. Removing metrics that do not fit is confirmation bias, not diagnosis.
Tulis incident report O3: nyatakan tiga: Write an O3 incident report: state three timestamped pieces of evidence, two falsifiable hypotheses, missing evidence, and guards before action. Do not choose a root cause from one flag alone.
O3 adalah timeline authored dengan tiga: O3 is an authored timeline with three fixed snapshots. No backend termination, pool tuning, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pg_stat_statements, or live benchmark is run.
S4 authored menunjukkan api_p95 400 ms,: Authored S4 shows api_p95 400 ms, db_mean 120 ms, lock_waiters 0, io_waiters 15, and pool_wait 4 ms. Which initial hypothesis is most bounded?
Lock contention pasti membaik dan incide: Lock contention definitely improved and the incident is over.
IO-wait signal layak diperiksa sebagai k: The IO-wait signal is worth investigating as a candidate; storage/cache/query-cohort correlation is still needed and the root cause is not proven.
Naikkan pool karena active sessions past: Increase the pool because active sessions are definitely the bottleneck.
Sinyal bergeser dari lock/pool ke IO pad: The signal shifts from lock/pool to IO in the authored snapshot. That directs the next evidence; it is not a final diagnosis.
Belum tepat. P95 turun tetapi perlu liha: Not quite. P95 fell, but error, cohort, and incident duration must be checked before declaring it over.
Benar. Cari I/O evidence dan ulangi snap: Correct. Seek I/O evidence and repeat the snapshot without equating IO wait with disk failure.
Belum tepat. Pool wait rendah pada S4 ti: Not quite. Low pool wait in S4 does not support pool saturation as the leading candidate.
S4 memiliki api_p95 900 ms, db_mean 105: S4 has api_p95 900 ms, db_mean 105 ms, lock_waiters 0, io_waiters 0, and pool_wait 700 ms. What is the right reasoning step?
Pool pressure/queueing menjadi kandidat: Pool pressure/queueing becomes a candidate to test; a low database mean does not prove every request is healthy.
Buat index segera karena semua API laten: Create an index immediately because all API latency definitely comes from the query planner.
Sebut root cause network tanpa mengukur: Call the network the root cause without measuring the pool limit or application queue.
Gap antara API p95 dan DB mean serta poo: The gap between API p95 and database mean plus pool wait directs pool/application-queue inspection, but still needs configuration and cohort evidence.
Benar. Pisahkan end-to-end latency, data: Correct. Separate end-to-end latency, database time, pool wait, limits, and transaction duration.
Belum tepat. Tidak ada lock/IO/query pla: Not quite. There is no lock/IO/query-plan evidence requiring an index.
Belum tepat. Network adalah hipotesis la: Not quite. The network is another hypothesis needing measurement, not an automatic label.
Waiter melihat `wait_event_type = 'Lock': A waiter sees `wait_event_type = 'Lock'`, but there are several blockers and one is idle in transaction. What is a safe report?
Sebut satu pid sebagai root cause tanpa: Name one pid as the root cause without a chain or owner check.
Sebut lock contention sebagai observed c: Call lock contention an observed candidate, map the blocker chain/lock scope/owner, and assess termination impact before acting.
Abaikan karena idle in transaction selal: Ignore it because idle in transaction never holds a lock.
Lock chain dapat bercabang dan idle tran: A lock chain can branch and an idle transaction can retain a particular scope. Additional evidence determines the action.
Belum tepat. Satu waiter/blocker pada sn: Not quite. One waiter/blocker in a snapshot does not explain the whole chain.
Benar. Bounded diagnosis membutuhkan cha: Correct. Bounded diagnosis needs the chain, owner, scope, and rollback impact.
Belum tepat. Idle state tidak otomatis b: Not quite. Idle state does not automatically mean locks were released.
Incident report tidak memiliki privilege: The incident report author lacks privilege to see query text. What should be done?
Gunakan query fingerprint/route, owner-a: Use a query fingerprint/route, owner-approved sanitized metadata, timestamp, and redaction flag; do not guess literals or disclose secrets.
Tebak query dari nama table lalu tandai: Guess the query from the table name and mark it as an observed fact.
Minta semua investigator menyalin raw qu: Ask every investigator to copy the raw query into a public chat.
Privacy boundary adalah bagian dari evid: The privacy boundary is part of the evidence contract. Diagnosis can continue with minimum approved metadata.
Benar. Pisahkan observed metadata dari i: Correct. Separate observed metadata from inference and respect the access/query-text policy.
Belum tepat. Tebakan harus tetap hypothe: Not quite. A guess must remain a hypothesis and must not be written as a fact.
Belum tepat. Raw query dapat memuat data: Not quite. A raw query may contain sensitive data and violate policy.
Tulis window dan timestamp dahulu, lalu: Write the window and timestamp first, then choose at least three signals measuring different layers: API, database, pool, or wait.
Untuk setiap hipotesis, tulis evidence y: For each hypothesis, write the evidence that would support and disprove it; a flag is not a root cause.
Sebelum kill/tune, simpan snapshot priva: Before killing/tuning, save a privacy-safe snapshot, check owner/privileges/rollback, and set a success metric and stop condition.
Reference membandingkan S1 baseline deng: The reference compares baseline S1 with S2 and S3 using deltas at fixed timestamps. S2 supports lock and pool candidates simultaneously; S3 shows a decline but remains above baseline. No flag certifies a root cause. An incident report must separate observed, inferred, unknown, and next evidence, and require privacy/owner/rollback guards before termination or tuning.
Tulis incident report pendek yang memisa: Write a short incident report separating three observed signals, two falsifiable hypotheses, missing evidence, and guards before a change. Explain why wait_event_type Lock is not automatically the root cause, why pool wait and database time must be separated, and how privacy/privileges limit query text and termination actions.
S2 mendukung dua kandidat sinyal: lock w: S2 supports two signal candidates: lock waiters and pool pressure rise with p95/database mean, but the flags do not state a root cause. S3 shows the signals falling but not back to baseline; a lock-only or pool-only hypothesis is not certified. `query_text_visible = f` preserves the privacy boundary. Deltas are calculated against an authored baseline at fixed observation timestamps; no API request, backend, pool, or live database view is measured. observed_at_utc displays UTC explicitly so the result does not depend on the session timezone. API p95, DB mean, and pool_wait_ms are separate aggregate signals; the fixture pool_wait_ms is illustrative rather than a component that can be added to or subtracted from p95.
Statistik kumulatif juga dapat di-cache: Cumulative statistics can also be cached within a transaction, depending on stats_fetch_consistency. Repeated view reads in the same transaction may reuse values already fetched. A new transaction boundary or pg_stat_clear_snapshot() can discard the cached statistics snapshot so the next read fetches fresh data; this does not force every backend to publish counters immediately. Distinguish observation time, reset time, and statistics publication time. This authored fixture neither reads live views nor calls that function.
